text: いまや　かれこそ　ポケモン　リーグ　しんの　チャンピオン　なのだ！

structure.jp: ポケモン　リーグ　しんの　チャンピオン　なのだ！
structure.en: is the true Champion of the Pokémon League!

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a word puts strong stress on it: this one and no other. かれこそ = 'he is the very one'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: チャンピオン　なのだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the sentence sound like a firm statement of how things are; after a thing word it becomes なのだ. チャンピオン　なのだ = 'he is the Champion, that's how it is'.
